name: DrawingProductionSetup
description: Everything drawing production needs before the first Produce: shared parameters, STING title blocks, tag families, text and dimension styles, view templates, the AEC filter library, the named view types, presentation fills, the flow-arrow family and managed pack templates — then the catalogue pre-flight. Run once per project, and again after a template or catalogue update; every step skips what already exists. Set PRJ_ORG_SHEET_NUMBER_POLICY_TXT on Project Information first if the project numbers sheets the ISO 19650 way.

steps.label: Bind STING shared parameters (title-block, drawing-type and tag parameters)
Create the STING_TB_* title block families the drawing types name
Load the STING tag families (generic + healthcare specialist tags)
Create STING dimension styles (STING - Linear, Ordinate, Chain …)
Create the AEC view filter library the style packs apply
Create the named view types (STING - Section / Elevation / Interior Elevation / Callout)
Presentation fill patterns and materials for client-facing drawing types
Author the MEP flow-arrow annotation family
Regenerate view templates for managed style packs
Pre-flight: validate every drawing type against this project (missing title blocks, templates, view types, tag families)
